capabilities: capture WeChat Official Account articles via share menu or clipboard link
convert article HTML to clean Markdown with frontmatter metadata
download remote article images into local attachments
save quick text memos from the mobile Mini Program
sync to multiple bound Obsidian devices with hash-based deduplication
disambiguation: Not a vault-to-vault file sync tool; 'sync' here means delivering captured WeChat articles and memos from a cloud buffer into the local vault.
extras: Cloud storage acts only as a transient sync buffer; notes are written directly to local vault files. Bilingual English/Chinese documentation with detailed binding walkthrough. Author solicits donations via Afdian. Listing carries the note 'This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.'
problem: Articles read in WeChat on a phone are hard to get into Obsidian cleanly; capture normally requires manual copying, cleanup, and Obsidian running at the time.

relations.evidence: 配合微信小程序 「Obsidian同步助手」，它可以将你在手机微信上浏览到的优质长文
Deployed globally on Cloudflare Workers and Cloudflare D1 (SQLite) with sub-10ms response times
Powered by Readability and custom Turndown AST rules to extract pure Markdown

summary: Capture and sync engine that saves WeChat Official Account articles, web pages, and mobile memos into an Obsidian vault as structured Markdown.
